scoring_policy.content: Per-question semantic partial credit; no bank-wide aggregate or inferred domain weights.
scoring_policy.instruction: Report format/instruction checks separately; instruction-task correctness requires all instruction checks.
scoring_policy.missing: Incomplete or ungradable content is null, never imputed zero. Tool-state partial credit is retained with outcome and tool checks.
scoring_policy.repeats: Retain every prespecified repetition; report completion and gradability denominators, never best-of.
scoring_policy.identity: Exact route, requested thinking, task/source hashes and execution protocol must accompany results.
scoring_policy.scope: Small exploratory capability bank, not a psychometrically validated scale.
